_what: Where the Media screen reads its library (media-library-read.ts): the person's own files, as their files owner keeps them (ns_name for each name, ns_file for each file's media type and whether its bytes are kept), read by `tool` with `credential_name`. A file is media when the first part of its media type is one of `kinds`. Rows come newest first, `limit` at a time; a page after the first starts after the last row of the one before. `views` says, for each saved view of the screen, which files it asks for: `stored` true or false, or every file when absent.
